title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Full Stack Engineer  

**Project Role Description :** Responsible for developing and/or engineering the end\-to\-end features of a system, from user experience to backend code. Use development skills to deliver innovative solutions that help our clients improve the services they provide. Leverage new technologies that can be applied to solve challenging business problems with a cloud first and agile mindset.
  

**Must have skills :** Java Full Stack Development, Spring Boot, React.js  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **7\.5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Full Stack Engineer, a typical day involves taking ownership of the complete development lifecycle of system features, ensuring seamless integration from the user interface to backend services. The role requires actively contributing to the design and implementation of innovative solutions that enhance client service delivery. The engineer collaborates with cross\-functional teams to adopt emerging technologies and applies an agile approach to address complex business challenges within a cloud\-first environment. This position demands a proactive mindset to continuously improve system performance and user experience through thoughtful engineering practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance development processes and product quality.
* Mentor junior team members to support their professional growth and skill development.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Java Full Stack Development, React.js, Spring Boot.
* Strong knowledge of front\-end technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks.
* Experience in designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and deployment strategies in a cloud\-first environment.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices.
* Experience with version control systems and collaborative development workflows.


  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7\.5 years of experience in Java Full Stack Development.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education

At PwC, our people in business application consulting specialise in consulting services for a variety of business applications, helping clients optimise operational efficiency. These individuals analyse client needs, implement software solutions, and provide training and support for seamless integration and utilisation of business applications, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives.
  

  

As a business application consulting generalist at PwC, you will provide consulting services for a wide range of business applications. You will leverage a broad understanding of various software solutions to assist clients in optimising operational efficiency through analysis, implementation, training, and support.

**Job Description \& Summary:** We are seeking an experienced Java Full\-Stack Developer with expertise in React to join our dynamic development team. The ideal candidate will have 6 to 8 years of experience in software development and a proven track record of delivering high\-quality applications. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web applications that meet our clients' needs.


**Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Java and React.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define and implement new features.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
* Troubleshoot and debug applications.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to team knowledge sharing.
* Stay up\-to\-date with emerging technologies and industry trends.
**Mandatory skill sets:**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in full\-stack development.
* Strong proficiency in Java and related frameworks (e.g., Spring, Hibernate).
* Azure cloud
* Solid experience with front\-end development using React.js.
* Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience with RESTful APIs and web services.
* Familiarity with database technologies such as SQL, NoSQL, and ORM.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
**Preferred skill sets:**

* Experience with cloud service providers like Azure, which can be crucial for developing scalable applications.
* Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes for managing containerized applications in a microservices architecture .
* Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, including tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, or Travis CI.
* Proficiency in using testing frameworks for both Java and React, such as JUnit, Mockito, Jest, or Mocha, to ensure robust software quality.
* Familiarity with modern front\-end build tools and libraries like Webpack, Babel, and npm /yarn.
* Knowledge of web application security principles and practices to protect against vulnerabilities such as XSS, CSRF, and SQL injection.
* Experience working in Agile development environments, including familiarity with Scrum or Kanban processes.
* Understanding of basic UI/UX principles to collaborate effectively with design teams and enhance user experience.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem\-solving and learning.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and driven Entry\-Level Full Stack Developer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining our web applications using modern front\-end and back\-end technologies, including Vue.js and Laravel.

**Responsibilities:**

**Front\-end Development:**

* Develop responsive and user\-friendly web interfaces using Vue.js
* Build reusable Vue components and leverage the component\-based architecture
* Integrate Vue applications with Restful APIs and handle data fetching
* Write unit tests for Vue.js components and features

**Back\-end Development:**

* Develop Restful APIs using Laravel
* Build database schemas and implement database queries using Laravel's Eloquent ORM.
* Implement authentication and authorisation mechanisms using Laravel's built\-in features
* Write automated tests for Laravel controllers, models, and other components

**General:**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including designers and product managers
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback
* Stay updated with the latest trends and best practices in web development

**Requirements:**

* Experience 3\+ years of experience in web development
* Strong proficiency in Vue.js and its ecosystem (Vue Router, Vuex, etc.)
* Solid understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
* Proficient in Laravel and PHP
* Experience with Restful API development
* Familiarity with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL)
* Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git)
* Understanding of responsive web design principles
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Good communication and teamwork abilities

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Any Bachelors

If you are a motivated individual with a passion for web development and a willingness to learn, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will design and develop scalable, resilient, and cloud\-native applications using modern technologies and methodologies. You will work in an Agile environment, delivering high\-quality solutions through continuous release and improvement cycles.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and develop rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular.
* Develop Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12\-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python.
* Implement Cloud\-Native CI/CD: Implement cloud\-native Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for change release, ensuring seamless delivery of applications and services.
* Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, content delivery, routing services, databases, event\-driven applications, and observability tools.

**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree

* Cloud\-Native Application Development: Experience with designing and developing scalable, resilient, and cloud\-native applications using modern technologies and methodologies, including microservices\-based modular designs and API\-driven microservices.
* Full Stack Development: Experience with developing rich UI applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, and scalable backend microservices based on 12\-factor principles, using frameworks such as ReactJS, Angular, Springboot, and programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python.

* Cloud\-Native CI/CD: Experience with implementing cloud\-native Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for change release, using tools such as CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, and CodeCommit.
* Event\-Driven Architecture: Experience with developing event\-driven applications using messaging and streaming services, such as Kafka, SQS, SNS, and Kinesis Streams.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Knowledge of No\-SQL Modelling: Experience working with modern No\-SQL modelling techniques for data model development.
* Familiarity with GraalVM: Exposure to GraalVM runtime for developing scalable and resilient backend microservices.

description:
Join us as a Lead Full Stack Engineer at Barclays, where youll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. Youll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences. To be a successful Lead Full Stack Engineer, you should have experience with: Technical Leadership & Solution Design Lead the design and development of complex, enterprise-scale applications across front-end, back-end, integration, and data layers. Define and promote engineering standards, coding practices, and architectural principles. Collaborate with Solution Architects and Technical Leads to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable. Drive technical decision-making and provide leadership on technology selection and implementation approaches. End-to-End Software Engineering Design, develop, test, deploy, and support software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle. Deliver high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested code leveraging modern engineering practices. Lead development of APIs, microservices, event-driven solutions, and cloud-native applications. Ensure operational stability through observability, monitoring, performance tuning, and production support. Agile Delivery Participate in Agile delivery processes including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives, and backlog refinement. Collaborate with Product Owners and Scrum Masters to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Support predictable delivery of business outcomes through effective estimation, planning, and execution. Engineering Excellence Champion DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and Infrastructure as Code practices. Drive continuous improvement in software quality, security, and delivery efficiency. Promote engineering metrics and data-driven decision-making. Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture, risk, compliance, and security standards. Stakeholder Management Partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and technical requirements. Communicate technical solutions and delivery risks effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Contribute to governance forums and technical design reviews. Talent Development & Mentoring Mentor engineers and provide technical coaching across product teams. Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. Support development of engineering capabilities and adoption of emerging technologies. Essential Extensive experience in Full Stack Software Engineering within complex enterprise environments. Strong experience in back-end development using Java, Spring Boot and related technologies. Experience designing and building REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures. Experience in Database Technologies - SQL and NoSQL (Oracle / Mongo) Experience with DevSecOps - PaaS Openshift / K8S, GitLab, JIRA, SonarQube, Prisma and Wiz, Maven or Gradle. Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, automated testing, and software quality engineering. Experience with event-streaming technologies such as Kafka and Message Queues. Experience of Rapid Application Development using AI models like Claude, GitLab Duo Computer Science degree or equivalent understanding of Computer Science, Object Oriented Design and Data Structures. Some other highly valued skills may include: Experience within Corporate Banking, Payments technology environments. Experience with distributed systems, high-volume transaction processing, and real-time integration platforms. Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience within Corporate Banking, Payments technology environments. Experience with distributed systems, high-volume transaction processing, and real-time integration platforms. Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. The role is based out of Pune. Purpose of the role To lead and manage engineering teams, providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions, driving technical excellence, fostering a culture of innovation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to align technical decisions with business objectives. Accountabilities Lead engineering teams effectively, fostering a collaborative and high-performance culture to achieve project goals and meet organizational objectives. Oversee timelines, team allocation, risk management and task prioritization to ensure the successful delivery of solutions within scope, time, and budget. Mentor and support team members professional growth, conduct performance reviews, provide actionable feedback, and identify opportunities for improvement. Evaluation and enhancement of engineering processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, streamline workflows, and optimize team productivity. Collaboration with business partners, product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and ensure a cohesive approach to product development. Enforcement of technology standards, facilitate peer reviews, and implement robust testing practices to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Vice President Expectations To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures. . If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements. . If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. . OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business. Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions. Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes. description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**Role Overview**


We are seeking an experienced Power Platform engineer to design and deliver complex enterprise solutions for clients while helping raise the technical capability of our broader Power Platform team.


This is a hands\-on player coach role with significant client delivery responsibility. The Manager will remain deeply involved in solution architecture, software development, troubleshooting, implementation, technical reviews, and client discussions. This is not a primarily administrative or people management position.


The ideal candidate is a software engineer with deep Microsoft Power Platform expertise who can combine low code capabilities with custom development, enterprise architecture, and strong consulting skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as a hands\-on engineer and technical lead for complex client engagements involving Microsoft Power Platform.
* Design and build enterprise applications using Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and related Microsoft technologies.
* Develop custom solutions using C\#/.NET, JavaScript or TypeScript, plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, and other extensibility approaches.
* Design scalable Dataverse architectures, including data models, security, integrations, business logic, and performance considerations.
* Integrate Power Platform solutions with Azure, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, APIs, and other enterprise systems.
* Implement strong ALM practices including source control, solution management, deployment automation, environment strategy, and CI/CD.
* Lead technical discovery sessions and translate business requirements into practical, well\-designed solutions.
* Communicate architecture decisions, tradeoffs, risks, estimates, and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple engagements and act as an escalation point for complex engineering challenges.
* Establish and promote engineering standards, reusable patterns, code quality expectations, and delivery best practices.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads and help improve engineering quality across the broader team.
* Help teams determine when Power Platform is the right solution and when custom development or other technologies are more appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8 or more years of professional software engineering, application development, solution architecture, or related technology experience.
* 4 or more years of substantial hands\-on Microsoft Power Platform engineering experience.
* Strong software development experience using C\#/.NET and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Experience extending Power Platform through plugins, custom APIs, PCF components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, or similar technologies.
* Strong understanding of Dataverse architecture, security, data modeling, integration patterns, solution management, and performance.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs and integrating with enterprise systems.
* Experience with Azure services, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, Dynamics 365, SQL, and related technologies.
* Strong experience with ALM, source control, deployment automation, managed solutions, and CI/CD.
* Strong understanding of professional software engineering practices including code review, testing, debugging, monitoring, and production support.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on complex enterprise application projects.
* Strong client facing communication, consulting, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to lead technical discussions, challenge assumptions, explain tradeoffs, and provide clear recommendations.
* Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team.
* Experience working with global clients and distributed delivery teams, including appropriate overlap with US based stakeholders when required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Power Platform governance, environment strategy, security standards, or Center of Excellence practices.
* Experience with Azure technologies such as Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, or Application Insights.
* Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
* Experience supporting presales, estimation, technical proposals, demonstrations, or workshops.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure certifications such as PL 400, PL 600, or related credentials.

**What Success Looks Like**


Successful engineers in this role remain highly engaged in client delivery while also raising the technical capability of the broader team. They are trusted by clients, comfortable solving difficult engineering problems, able to make sound architecture decisions, and capable of guiding others through complex technical challenges.


They approach Power Platform as an enterprise application development platform and combine its native capabilities with strong software engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions.

 **What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  

  

**How You Can Grow:**  

We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  

  

**More about Crowe:**


Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.

description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


**About the Organisation \& Role:**


You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.


As a Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack), you will build backend services for the membership and loyalty capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, development and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer, Product Owner and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences. You will also be building reusable assets for consistent development and delivery.


**What you will do:**


* Design, build, and operate scalable, low\-latency APIs, event\-driven services, and integration layers that support real\-time and batch membership, loyalty, rewards, and consumer engagement use cases.
* Develop and evolve customer\-facing web applications and supporting backend services, ensuring a seamless and consistent membership and loyalty experience across digital channels.
* Configure, extend, and integrate the Antavo loyalty platform, including custom workflows, reward mechanisms, member lifecycle processes, event processing, and promotional capabilities.
* Design and implement integrations between Antavo and enterprise commerce platforms such as SFCC, Fluent Commerce, CDP, CRM, marketing automation, and data platforms to support accurate and near real\-time member data synchronisation.
* Apply distributed systems principles including asynchronous processing, idempotency, caching, retries, circuit breakers, and event\-driven architectures to build resilient and reliable member experiences at scale.
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient by implementing engineering best practices for monitoring, logging and performance optimisation.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Lead Engineers, Architects, Data Engineers, and AI/ML Engineers to deliver business capabilities and contribute to technical design decisions.
* Contribute to engineering standards, reusable libraries, reference implementations, and platform capabilities that improve consistency, maintainability, and developer experience across teams.
* Troubleshoot production issues through monitoring, logging, crash analysis, and root cause investigation.
* Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, share technical knowledge, and promote engineering best practices across the team
**Your talent**
---------------


* 7\+ years of experience designing and building large scale distributed backend systems on cloud\-native platforms.
* Experience implementing or integrating enterprise loyalty platforms (Antavo preferred), including member lifecycle management, rewards, promotions, campaign execution, and loyalty transaction processing.
* Strong understanding of design patterns, data structures and algorithms, with practical experience applying them to real\-world use cases.
* Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
* Working knowledge of React and modern frontend development practices sufficient to contribute to customer\-facing applications.
* Experience with Node.js and related frameworks.
* Experience in event streaming platforms like Kafka.
* Experience with SQL/No\-SQL databases with understanding of database architecture and distributed data management.
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.
* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
===================

**Infrastructure Engineer Intern**
----------------------------------

**Location:** Bangalore – Brookfield**Department:** IT Infrastructure / Technology**Employment Type:** Internship – Full\-Time**Working Hours:** 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturdays Off)**Experience:** Fresher / Recent Graduate / Intern### **About the Role**


We are looking for a motivated and technically strong **Infrastructure Engineer Intern** to join our IT Infrastructure and Technology team.
The candidate will receive hands\-on exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Endpoint support
* Operating systems
* Monitoring
* Cybersecurity
* Backups
* Databases
* Application platforms
* Infrastructure operations


The candidate must also have a **basic understanding of Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack development**, as the role involves supporting the infrastructure on which business applications and software platforms operate.
The ideal candidate should be interested in building a career in:  

* Infrastructure Engineering
* System Administration
* Network Administration
* DevOps
* Cloud Infrastructure
* IT Operations

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Infrastructure Management**
---------------------------------

* Assist in deploying, configuring, and maintaining on\-premises physical servers.
* Support environments consisting of multiple physical servers and virtual machines.
* Assist in managing servers deployed at client locations.
* Support virtualization environments and VM lifecycle management.
* Assist with VM creation, configuration, maintenance, backup, and decommissioning.
* Assist with IP allocation and network configuration.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and configuration records.
* Support infrastructure capacity and resource monitoring.

**2\. Server Management**
-------------------------

* Assist in administering Linux, Windows, and macOS environments.
* Gain exposure to Dell and HP physical servers.
* Monitor server health and system performance.
* Assist in troubleshooting CPU, memory, storage, and performance issues.
* Monitor server availability and application services.
* Assist with database server and application platform administration.
* Perform basic server maintenance under supervision.
* Assist with patching, updates, and routine infrastructure activities.

**3\. End\-User Device \& Desktop Support**
-------------------------------------------

* Provide first\-level technical support for laptops, desktops, printers, and peripherals.
* Diagnose and resolve basic hardware and software issues.
* Troubleshoot driver and peripheral connectivity problems.
* Install and configure operating systems and applications.
* Prepare, image, and configure laptops/desktops for new employees.
* Support employee onboarding and IT setup.
* Maintain proper records of assigned IT equipment.

**4\. Operating System Administration**
---------------------------------------


Assist with installation, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of:  

* Windows
* Ubuntu/Linux
* macOS

**Responsibilities include:**  

* OS installation and configuration.
* Software and application installation.
* Driver troubleshooting.
* OS updates and patching.
* Boot and startup troubleshooting.
* Performance troubleshooting.
* Application compatibility troubleshooting.
* Basic system security configuration.

**5\. Network Infrastructure Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Assist in configuring and troubleshooting network switches.
* Support routers and wireless access points.
* Troubleshoot LAN and Wi\-Fi connectivity.
* Assist with IP addressing and network configuration.
* Understand basic VLAN and network segmentation concepts.
* Assist with firewall configuration and monitoring.
* Monitor firewall logs and identify unusual traffic.
* Assist with VPN configuration and remote connectivity.
* Support secure external access.
* Assist with periodic firewall rule reviews.
* Learn basic network performance optimization.
* Troubleshoot connectivity, latency, and network performance issues.

**6\. Endpoint Security \& Antivirus Management**
-------------------------------------------------

* Assist in deploying and managing Seqrite Antivirus and Endpoint Security.
* Monitor endpoint security status.
* Monitor malware and virus alerts.
* Assist with quarantine and security incident handling.
* Ensure endpoint definitions and security policies remain updated.
* Assist with endpoint security agent installation.
* Troubleshoot antivirus agent connectivity and installation issues.
* Maintain basic endpoint security documentation.

**7\. Infrastructure Monitoring**
---------------------------------


Assist in administering and maintaining:  

* Zabbix
* Uptime Monitoring
* Grafana
* SigNoz

**Responsibilities include:**  

* Monitor server availability.
* Monitor VM availability.
* Track CPU utilization.
* Track memory utilization.
* Monitor disk and storage utilization.
* Monitor application and service availability.
* Review alerts and logs.
* Assist in troubleshooting infrastructure alerts.
* Maintain monitoring dashboards.
* Support proactive infrastructure monitoring.

**8\. CCTV Infrastructure Support**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor CCTV system health and uptime.
* Ensure network connectivity to CCTV cameras.
* Troubleshoot basic camera connectivity issues.
* Monitor video feed availability.
* Assist with CCTV hardware and software troubleshooting.
* Monitor CCTV storage.
* Assist with surveillance footage archiving.
* Ensure required retention policies are followed.

**9\. Backup \& Storage Management**
------------------------------------

* Assist in maintaining backup infrastructure.
* Monitor scheduled backups.
* Verify successful completion of backups.
* Identify and report backup failures.
* Assist with database and server backup activities.
* Perform basic backup validation.
* Assist with restoration testing.
* Maintain backup documentation.
* Gain practical exposure to disaster recovery concepts.

**10\. IT Asset Management**
----------------------------

* Maintain hardware and software inventory.
* Track laptops, desktops, servers, monitors, printers, and networking equipment.
* Maintain asset allocation records.
* Track asset lifecycle and replacement requirements.
* Assist with procurement activities.
* Maintain infrastructure and asset documentation.
* Ensure proper handover and return of IT assets.

**11\. Core Platform Services**
-------------------------------

* Gain practical exposure to LDAP and directory services.
* Assist with basic identity and access management.
* Support user and system access activities under supervision.
* Maintain infrastructure room and server room documentation.
* Assist with physical infrastructure inspections.
* Maintain proper organization of network and server equipment.
* Follow infrastructure security and operational procedures.

**12\. Frontend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
===================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Frontend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* Basic frontend application architecture.
* Basic understanding of browser and client\-server communication.
* Understanding of frontend build and deployment concepts.
* Basic understanding of API integration.
* Basic troubleshooting of frontend application issues.

### **Preferred**

* React
* Angular
* Vue.js
* npm
* Frontend build tools


The candidate should understand how a frontend application is hosted, deployed, accessed, and connected to backend services.**13\. Backend Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
==================================================


The candidate must have basic knowledge of **Backend development**.### **Required Understanding**

* Basic backend application architecture.
* REST APIs.
* HTTP/HTTPS.
* API requests and responses.
* Authentication and authorization concepts.
* Application\-server communication.
* Basic backend troubleshooting.
* Basic database connectivity.

### **Backend Technologies**


Candidate should have exposure to at least one backend technology/language such as:  

* Java
* Python
* Node.js
* PHP
* .NET


The candidate should be able to understand how backend applications run on servers and communicate with databases and frontend applications.**14\. Full\-Stack Development Knowledge – MANDATORY**
======================================================


The candidate must have a basic understanding of **Full\-Stack application architecture**.
The candidate should understand the relationship between:**Frontend API/Backend Database Backend Frontend**### **Basic Knowledge Should Include**

* Frontend application structure.
* Backend/API structure.
* Database interaction.
* REST APIs.
* Application deployment.
* Server\-side application hosting.
* Basic application troubleshooting.
* Basic understanding of logs and application errors.
* Basic understanding of application\-server communication.


The candidate is **not required to be an expert Full\-Stack Developer**, but must understand how a complete application works across frontend, backend, database, server, and network layers.**15\. Database Knowledge – MANDATORY**
=======================================

* Basic understanding of databases.
* Basic SQL knowledge.
* Understanding of tables, records, and queries.
* Basic knowledge of relational databases.
* Understanding of application\-to\-database connectivity.
* Basic database troubleshooting.

### **Preferred Database Exposure**

* MySQL
* PostgreSQL
* SQL Server
* Similar databases

**16\. DevOps \& Development Tools**
====================================


Basic exposure to the following will be an advantage:  

* Git
* GitHub/GitLab
* Docker
* CI/CD concepts
* Build and deployment processes
* Shell scripting
* Python scripting
* Linux command line
* Application logs
* Environment variables
* Basic cloud concepts

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
==============================


The candidate must have basic knowledge or academic/project exposure to:### **Infrastructure**

* Infrastructure
* Linux/Ubuntu
* Windows
* Computer hardware
* Servers
* Virtual machines

### **Networking**

* Networking fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* DHCP
* LAN/Wi\-Fi
* Routers and switches
* Basic firewall concepts

### **Development**

* **Frontend – Mandatory**
* **Backend – Mandatory**
* **Full\-Stack concepts – Mandatory**
* **Database/SQL – Mandatory**
* REST APIs
* HTTP/HTTPS
* Basic application architecture

### **Security \& Monitoring**

* Basic cybersecurity concepts
* Antivirus/Endpoint Security
* System monitoring
* Logs and troubleshooting

**Preferred Technical Exposure**
================================


Candidates having exposure to the following will be preferred:  

* Zabbix
* Grafana
* SigNoz
* Uptime Monitoring
* Docker
* Git/GitHub
* CI/CD
* Shell scripting
* Python
* LDAP
* Active Directory
* VPN
* Firewall administration
* Cloud platforms
* Database administration
* Backup and disaster recovery

**Educational Qualification**
=============================

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* BCA / MCA or equivalent IT qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates are welcome.
* Candidates with academic projects in Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, Full\-Stack Development, or System Administration are preferred.

**Candidate Profile**
=====================


We are looking for someone who:  

* Has a strong interest in IT Infrastructure and Technology.
* Has basic knowledge of both Infrastructure and Software Development.
* Is comfortable working with Linux and Windows.
* Understands basic networking concepts.
* Has basic Frontend, Backend, and Full\-Stack knowledge.
* Has good troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Is willing to work hands\-on with servers, networks, systems, and applications.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Has good communication and teamwork skills.
* Is willing to work in an onsite infrastructure environment.

**Key Learning Opportunities**
==============================


During the internship, the candidate will gain practical exposure to:  

* Server administration
* Linux administration
* Windows administration
* Virtualization
* Networking
* Firewalls and VPN
* Endpoint security
* Zabbix and Grafana monitoring
* Application monitoring
* Database environments
* Backup and disaster recovery
* CCTV infrastructure
* IT asset management
* LDAP
* Frontend applications
* Backend applications
* Full\-Stack architecture
* APIs
* Application deployment
* DevOps fundamentals
* Infrastructure troubleshooting

**Career Path**
===============


This internship can provide a foundation for careers in:  

* Infrastructure Engineer
* System Administrator
* Network Engineer
* DevOps Engineer
* Cloud Engineer
* IT Operations Engineer
* Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
* Application Support Engineer
* Full\-Stack Infrastructure/Platform Engineer

**Internship\-to\-Hire**
========================


Based on **performance, technical skills, learning ability, discipline, and organizational requirements**, the successful intern may be considered for a **full\-time employment opportunity after completion of the internship**.**Important Requirement**
=========================


Candidates with only basic desktop\-support knowledge and no understanding of **Frontend, Backend, Full\-Stack, APIs, and databases** will not be considered suitable for this position.
The role requires a combination of:**Infrastructure \+ Networking \+ Systems \+ Application \+ Development knowledge.**

description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java, Angular \& Cloud Infrastructure)
 
 Location: Jaipur / Gift City, Gujarat, India Experience: 5\+ Years Employment Type: Full\-time
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who thrives at the intersection of robust backend services and scalable cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for designing and implementing mission\-critical applications, ensuring that our technical architecture is as scalable as our business vision. We value clean code, automated infrastructure, and a “security\-first” mindset.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * End\-to\-End Development: Design, develop, and maintain complex backend services using Java 17/21 and Spring Boot 3\.x.
* Frontend Excellence: Build responsive, high\-performance web interfaces using Angular (v17\+) and modern state management (RxJS/Signals).
* Infrastructure as Code: Own the cloud lifecycle by writing and maintaining Terraform scripts to manage AWS resources.
* Security \& Identity: Implement and manage secure authentication/authorization flows using OAuth2, JWT, and OpenID Connect (Keycloak).
* Database Management: Design schema and optimize queries for PostgreSQL or similar relational databases.
* Architecture \& Mentorship: Lead technical decisions, conduct rigorous code reviews, and ensure the team adheres to SOLID principles and design patterns.


 Technical RequirementsBackend (Java / J2EE / Spring Boot)
 * Deep expertise in Spring Boot 3\.x, Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA.
* Strong understanding of Microservices architecture and RESTful API design.
* Experience with build tools like Maven or Gradle and JVM tuning.
* Bonus: Experience with document processing libraries (Apache POI/iText) or Blockchain integration.


 Frontend (Angular)
 * Proficiency in TypeScript and Angular 17\+ (Standalone components, Reactive Forms).
* Solid grasp of RxJS for asynchronous stream handling.
* Experience with UI frameworks like Angular Material or Tailwind CSS.


 Cloud \& DevOps (AWS \& Terraform)
 * Hands\-on experience with AWS services: EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, and VPC.
* Proven ability to manage environments using Terraform (Modules, State management).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI).


 General
 * Expertise in Git and version control workflows.
* Strong understanding of Docker and Containerization.
* Ability to write comprehensive unit and integration tests (JUnit, Mockito, Jasmine/Jest).


 What We Look For
 * Problem Solvers: You don’t just write code; you solve business problems with elegant technical solutions.
* Architectural Thinking: You understand the “why” behind technology choices, not just the “how.”
* Self\-Starters: You are comfortable working in an environment where you are expected to take ownership of a feature from conception to production.


 Why Join Us?
 * Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge financial technology/tokenization projects.
* A culture that values “Peace of Mind” and high\-quality engineering standards.

description:
About Us: 
 CLOUDSUFI, a Google Cloud Premier Partner, is a global leading provider of data-driven digital transformation across cloud-based enterprises. With a global presence and focus on Software & Platforms, Life sciences and Healthcare, Retail, CPG, financial services and supply chain, CLOUDSUFI is positioned to meet customers where they are in their data monetization journey. 
 Our Values We are a passionate and empathetic team that prioritizes human values. Our purpose is to elevate the quality of lives for our family, customers, partners and the community. 
 Equal Opportunity Statement CLOUDSUFI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation and national origin status. We provide equal opportunities in employment, advancement, and all other areas of our workplace. Please explore more at https://www.cloudsufi.com/ 
 About the role 
 Role Summary: Software Engineer, Internal AI Products 
 A Software Engineer who builds the tools this company runs on. You build agent loops, and the loops build the solutions. You work towards a Company Brain that anyone here can ask.35 years’ experience • Reports to the CFO •  
 THE KEY SKILL: You build the agent loops that build the solutions. You will not write every automation by hand. You build the loops that
write them. Ship a prototype every week. You ship something every day. You’ll be building a Company Brain with access control. One system that holds what the company knows about finance,delivery and people. Anyone can ask it a question. Each person sees only what they are cleared to see. One hard filter. If you cannot write and debug production code, and have not done it before, please do not apply. 
 CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: Work the backlog: You pick items off a live, ranked backlog. You learn each function by building inside it. There is no discovery phase. What you learn goes back into the backlog and changes what comes next. Build the product: You design, build and ship tools that people use every day. Reconciliation, MIS, the deal desk,quote to cash, or whatever the real bottleneck turns out to be. You choose the tools and frameworks. Wire the data: Connect the systems each team already uses, so that the same number means the same thing everywhere. Make it visible: You build live dashboards and alerts that leaders read on their own, instead of asking someone for a report. Keep it running: You own uptime and accuracy for everything you build. Anything that touches money or people needs a person in the loop. 
 THE STACK: 
 Build with: Python and TypeScript. You write production code. Frontier model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI or Google, with tool calling and structured output. At least one agent framework. MCP to connect agents to internal systems.Postgres and pgvector, or something similar, for retrieval. You deploy on GCP, and you debug your own work. Work in agents daily: Claude Code, Cursor or something like them, as the way you write code every day. You should have a clear view on how to run the loop, and on when a person has to step in. Connect to: The systems we already run on for accounting, CRM, hiring and IT support, along with Google Workspace.Most of the work is getting them to agree with each other. Check what you ship: Anything that produces a number needs a way to catch it going quietly wrong. Test sets, regression checks, and alerts on the output as well as on the job. 
 WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE: Something you built is running by week two, and someone is using it.
• By day 90, time spent on reconciliation or reporting is down by a number you can defend to the CFO.
• Every tool you ship has a named owner who is still using it 60 days later. That is the measure that counts.
• Leaders stop asking for numbers, because they can already see them.
• By the end of your first year, a first version of the Company Brain answers real questions about Finance, and each
person who asks sees only what they are cleared to see. 
 WHO THIS IS FOR: You have built products: 3 to 5 years at a software product company, on a product with real users at scale. That means 100k+ monthly active users, or heavy daily use by a large enterprise customer base. You have owned code in production, in front of real users, long after it shipped.
• You ship alone: You are comfortable as the only engineer in the room, and the only person on call for what you built.
• You work out new ground fast : A domain you do not know is interesting to you. You start without waiting for a spec or an expert.
• You are fluent with agents: One person cannot cover a whole company by hand. You use agent loops heavily and youare good at it.
• You write and speak clearly: Half this job is pulling a process out of a finance or delivery lead and giving it back to them correctly. You work remotely, so this matters a great deal. 
 HOW WE WILL ASSESS: 
• A design problem: Live. We give you a function of the B2B company, and you design the system for it. We watch how you break down a domain you do not know, how you size it, and what you leave out on purpose.
• A build exercise: Live and screen-shared, on your own setup, with your own agents. You build the way you normally build. We watch how you run the loop, when you step in, and what you decide to skip.
• Your work and your questions: We talk about what you have shipped before. You ask us whatever you want. Communication is not a separate round. All three sessions are live, and how clearly you explain your thinking is part of how we judge you. 
 WHERE IT LEADS 
You report to the CEO and CFO from your first day. Your charter covers the whole company. Nothing sits between you and production. Very few engineering jobs offer all three at once, and that is why this one exists.
In 18 months you will know how this company really runs: the data, the money, and the gaps between teams. The rolethen changes shape to fit whatever the biggest open problem is by then. 
 Note : Interested candidates can share their CVs at lishta.jain@cloudsufi.com .

title: Full-Stack AI Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India\-based) — Bengaluru preferred; with meaningful daily overlap with our UK and US teams
   

  

**Engagement Type:** 
 Full\-time — permanent, ongoing
   

  

**About MarcoPolo Learning**
 MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy\-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.
   

  

 Backed by top\-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion \& Coach — a guided AI assistant that helps early\-learning educators plan lessons, discover the right materials, and improve classroom outcomes. We’re looking for a Full\-Stack AI Engineer to help bring Audrey to life and shape where she goes next.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 This is a role for an engineer who loves working where AI meets product. You’ll own the intelligence behind Audrey — the retrieval, generation, and logic that make her genuinely useful to teachers — while being just as comfortable moving across the backend and frontend to bring the whole experience together. You’ll work alongside our backend, infrastructure, and frontend engineers, with real ownership of the AI and real influence over what we build.
   

  

 Audrey is approaching an exciting launch, and you’ll play a central part in shaping her — refining how she works today and helping define where she goes as we grow into more classrooms.
   

  

 Just as much as the engineering, we care about instinct for the product. We’re looking for someone genuinely curious about the teachers we serve — an engineer who asks the right questions, understands how educators actually use what we build, and lets that understanding shape the experience. You’ll bring deep AI expertise, a natural instinct for collaboration, and a calm, considered approach to solving hard problems.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own the AI at the heart of Audrey — retrieval, generation, and the models and logic that make her intelligent and dependable.
* Craft an experience where teachers instantly find exactly the right video, printable, or activity, with retrieval that’s fast, accurate, and reliable.
* Build and refine the content and data pipelines that power Audrey — ingesting and structuring videos, printables, guides, and multilingual content for precise retrieval.
* Work across the full stack, connecting the AI seamlessly into the wider product alongside our backend and frontend engineers.
* Shape how Audrey thinks, responds, and guides teachers — designing her behavior, personality, and overall experience with the end user always in mind.
* Help bring Audrey to launch and shape her evolution as we scale.
* Continuously raise the quality, speed, and reliability of Audrey’s responses and recommendations.
* Build fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools to design, build, and iterate quickly.
* Partner with our infrastructure lead to keep Audrey running smoothly and efficiently in the cloud.
* Put in place the evaluation, testing, and monitoring that keep quality high, and keep technical documentation clear.
* Collaborate closely and openly with engineering and product, sharing your thinking and progress early and often.
* Help shape the product roadmap — from deeper personalization to multilingual support and classroom insights.
* Build with privacy and safety in mind, including FERPA/COPPA alignment.


**What We’re Looking For**
* 5\+ years of software engineering experience across the full stack, comfortable working fluidly between backend and frontend.
* Proven, hands\-on depth with modern AI: you’ve personally built and shipped at least one production LLM/AI application. We know the LLM tooling is only a few years old — what you’ve actually built matters far more to us than years on a résumé.
* Strong experience building retrieval\-augmented (RAG) systems — embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and re\-ranking — with a real feel for what makes retrieval accurate and dependable.
* An AI\-native engineer who builds fluently with modern AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Cursor) and weaves AI through their workflow.
* Strong Python and solid backend fundamentals (APIs, databases, data pipelines), with enough frontend ability to work end\-to\-end across the stack.
* Practical LLM orchestration and prompt engineering (LangChain or comparable), including agent/tool design, system\-prompt and persona design, and guardrails.
* Solid AWS experience (compute, storage, databases, containers, monitoring); familiarity with managed model services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock) and/or self\-hosted model inference is a plus.
* A genuine product sensibility — you’re curious about the people who use what you build, and you let that shape your work.
* A natural collaborator who communicates openly, builds trust across teams, and brings a calm, considered approach to a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfortable owning your work and driving it forward with minimal oversight.
* Able to work remotely with meaningful overlap across UK and US time zones, with strong written communication.
* Bonus: edtech or early\-childhood education experience; multilingual retrieval; video/audio ML; familiarity with FERPA/COPPA or similar.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive, market\-aligned salary for an experienced engineer in India.
* Fully remote, full\-time role with flexibility over how you structure your day.
* End\-to\-end ownership of the AI behind a flagship product, from launch through scale, with real influence over its architecture and roadmap.
* A collaborative, family\-friendly, mission\-driven environment at the intersection of education, media, and technology.


**Why Join Us**
 This is a rare chance to own the AI capabilities of a growing global education company at a defining moment. You’ll be the engineer who brings Audrey to life, shapes how she’s built, and helps take her from launch to a product used in thousands of classrooms. If you want work that’s visible, technically meaningful, and genuinely impactful for young learners and their teachers, this is it.
   

  

*Note: This is an India\-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.*
 MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. We pride ourselves on a supportive and mission\-driven working environment.

**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within Asset and Wealth Management Technology and Alternative Investments Technology team, you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. The role may include building mobile features that give customers and clients greater control over how they bank with us, shaping how big data can accelerate our trading systems, driving the next wave of merchant payments innovation, and supporting the integration of private and public cloud platforms.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Designs, develops, debugs and maintains applications built Java 21/Spring Boot microservices handling, React/TypeScript frontends, Vite.
* Manages Terraform infrastructure configurations deploying to AWS ECS
* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Produces or contributes to architecture and design artifacts for applications while ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Contributes to software engineering communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies
* Adds to team culture of diversity, opportunity, inclusion, and respect


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing and operational stability
* Proficient in coding in Java \& React, JavaScript languages
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security
* Knowledge of software applications and technical processes within a technical discipline (e.g., cloud, artificial intelligence, machine learning, mobile, etc.)


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Experience with AWS Cloud


**ABOUT US**

title: Fullstack Developer (.Net+Angular)
description:
**Company Description** **Eurofins Scientific** is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.


The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products.


In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.


In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description** **Required Experience and Skills**

* 1\-4 years of experience with developing end\-to\-end web applications using Microsoft stack of technologies.
* Strong working knowledge of Web application development using .NET, C\#, Asp.net, MVC, WebAPI.
* Strong Working knowledge of Angular 2 or above, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Good working knowledge of Cosmos DB, MSSQL – SQL etc.
* Experience with usage of TFS
* Familiar UI testing and Unit Testing (MS Test/ Jasmine/ MOQ/ NUnit/ Karma etc.)
* Good understanding of object\-oriented programming (OOP)
* Strong working knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns that includes Creational, Structural, Behavioral
* Strong experience in designing and working with n\-tier architectures
* Able to provide technical recommendations and solve technical problems
* Should have working knowledge on Code review that includes, raising code review, resolve comment reviews, Closing code reviews.
* Should be aware of best practices in programming
* Should know how to troubleshoot performance\-related issues, how to write efficient code and query, how to use SQL profiler
* Working knowledge Authentication and Authorization \[Plus OAuth2, OpenIDC etc.] (5\+)
* Should have worked on at least one SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) project
* Should have worked in an AGILE practice methodology (preferably SCRUM)

  

**Additional Information** **Personal Skills:**

* Customer\-service oriented with a problem\-solving attitude;
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy is essential;
* Entrepreneurial thinking and flexibility to change;
* Very good English communication skills (concise writing and orally convincing);
* Structured and clear writing skills;
* Proven ability to solve complex business problems using analytical reasoning;
* Demonstrated positive attitude, self\-motivated, team player.

**PERFORMANCE APPRAISAL CRITERIA**: Eurofins has a strong focus on Performance Management system. This includes quarterly calibrations, half\-yearly reviews and annual reviews. The KPIs shall be set and may vary slightly between projects. These will be clearly communicated, documented during the first 30 days of your joining.

title: Senior Full-Stack Developer — .NET, Azure & Angular
description:
Senior Full\-Stack Developer — .NET, Azure \& Angular

Experience: 5\+ years  
Location / Work model: Onsite in Bangalore

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Full\-Stack Developer with deep hands\-on expertise in .NET Core, Azure cloud services, and modern Angular front\-end development. The role requires someone who can independently own complex backend modules end\-to\-end, contribute to distributed system and microservice design, and work fluently across the full stack — from Azure Functions and Web APIs on the backend to Angular components and RxJS\-driven data flows on the front end. Familiarity with Ruby (or another scripting language) is also required to support automation, integration, and operational tasks.

You will work closely with backend engineers, front\-end developers, DevOps, QA, and product stakeholders to deliver production\-grade, cloud\-native software with strong engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using .NET Core, C\#, and Web APIs
* Build and operate cloud\-native solutions on Microsoft Azure — Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, and Key Vault
* Contribute to and evolve CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps using YAML\-based configurations and Git\-based workflows
* Develop responsive front\-end features in Angular, leveraging components, services, and RxJS for reactive data flows
* Write clean, testable, and maintainable code aligned to SOLID principles and modern software engineering practices
* Author scripts and utilities in Ruby (or an equivalent scripting language) to automate integration, deployment, and operational workflows
* Contribute to the design of RESTful services, distributed systems, and microservice architectures
* Model, query, and tune data structures across Cosmos DB, other NoSQL stores, or SQL databases as appropriate to the workload
* Participate actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architectural decision\-making
* Troubleshoot production issues, drive root\-cause analysis, and implement long\-term fixes
* Take ownership of features from design through deployment, with a focus on quality, performance, reliability, and security
* Collaborate with distributed cross\-functional teams across the full software delivery lifecycle

Mandatory Technical Skills

* 5\+ years of professional hands\-on software development experience
* .NET Core \& C\# — strong proficiency in modern .NET, async / await patterns, dependency injection, and idiomatic C\#
* Web API development
* Async programming
* Azure cloud platform, with hands\-on experience across:
* o Azure Functions (serverless compute)o Azure DevOps — CI/CD, YAML pipelines, repositorieso App Serviceso Azure Storage (Blob, Queue, Table as relevant)o Key Vault (secrets and configuration management)
* Databases — working knowledge of Cosmos DB, another NoSQL store, or the SQL Server suite (T\-SQL, indexing, query tuning)
* Angular front\-end
* Ruby or Python or PowerShell or Bash)
* DevOps
* Distributed systems — strong understanding of RESTful services, service boundaries, eventual consistency, and microservice design patterns

Good to Have

* Containerisation with Docker; orchestration with Kubernetes (AKS)
* Messaging platforms — Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, RabbitMQ, or Kafka
* API security — OAuth 2\.0, JWT, OpenID Connect, API gateway patterns
* Testing frameworks — xUnit, NUnit, MSTest on the backend; Jasmine, Karma, or Jest on the front\-end
* Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Observability — Application Insights, Log Analytics, Prometheus / Grafana
* Front\-end tooling — Vite, Webpack, Nx workspaces
* Domain\-Driven Design and Clean Architecture patterns
* Agile / Scrum delivery experience

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving
* Ability to own complex modules independently from design to production
* Clear written and verbal communication, comfortable working with distributed teams and client stakeholders
* Willingness to mentor junior engineers and contribute to team\-wide engineering standards
* Proactive attitude to code quality, technical debt, and continuous improvement

Pay: ₹1,900,000\.00 \- ₹2,100,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays.
   

  

 The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and in 2019 we invested 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

 The Global Service Support Organization (GSS) team headquartered in Milpitas, CA, is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The GSS organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts.
   

  

 The GSS organization's Engineering group develops data systems for improved diagnostics and predictive maintenance. The data systems monitor the performance of fleets of KLA test and measurement equipment in semiconductor fabrication plant environments. They collect, transform, and store data. They provide visualizations, recommendations based on analytics, and alerts. This exciting position will enable you to interact with a wide variety of engineers and KLA system data.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

 Do you have a passion for coding, data exploration, and UI design? Are you looking for a role where you can develop reactive, modern user interfaces working with highly collaborative teams?
   

  

 As a Software engineer, you will work with our team of software, data and algorithm engineers on the design and development of web applications using real\-time data visualization tools. Collaborating with domain experts and software engineers, you will gather requirements, translate user needs to design and develop software specifications, select software components, follow best coding practices, and develop User Interfaces that help our engineers to more effectively monitor, diagnose and optimize KLA semiconductor inspection and metrology equipment.
   

  

 Required qualifications:
